title: Solar Powered Exhaust Fan Monocrystalline Silicon 20w 5V Solar Panel Vent Fan Kit With Round Baffle For Greenhouse RV Boat
body_html: 1、HIGH EFFICIENCY COOLING: The solar exhaust fan can provide strong wind to keep the space cool and comfortable, ensuring efficient cooling and wind circulation. 2、ENERGY SAVING SOLUTION: The 20W solar panel serves as a reliable power source, which reduces power costs, minimizes environmental impact, and saves energy and power. 3、SIMPLE INSTALLATION: The solar panel vent fan kit is suitable for round ducts, which is easy to install quickly in any ventilation system without professional tools and skills. 4、ROUND BANNER: It comes with a mounting baffle, which can effectively prevent birds from entering and nesting inside the exhaust fan, ensuring safety and reliability. 5、WIDE APPLICATION: It is ideal for different spaces and environments such as attics, greenhouses, RVs, boats, chicken coops, pet houses, sheds, etc. to meet various needs.Item Type: Solar Powered Exhaust FanMaterial: Monocrystalline Silicon, ABSSolar Panel Power: 20W (Without Power Storage)Solar Panel Size: Approx. 14.5x14.5cm / 5.7x5.7inExhaust Fan Diameter: 12cm / 4.7inExhaust Duct Length: 5.5cm / 2.2inExhaust Duct Diameter: 9.5cm / 3.7inVoltage: 5V1 x Solar Panel 1 x Exhaust Fan1 x Exhaust Fan Round Baffle4 x Screw4 x Expansion Bolt
